FAQ

Is acne caused by dirty skin?

Acne is not caused by having dirty skin. A combination of factors may contribute to breakouts, including excess oil production, clogged pores, bacteria and hormonal changes.

Maintaining a consistent skincare routine and cleansing the skin regularly can help support healthy-looking skin, but over-cleansing and harsh scrubbing may sometimes aggravate skin concerns.
